listing.name: Stop Stacking Me
listing.summary: Draws one sprite per cargo stack, instead of a pile of grey ghost copies behind it.
listing.aiSummary: Draws a single sprite for each cargo stack instead of multiple overlapping copies.

description:
StopStackingMe

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- Draws one sprite per cargo stack, instead of a pile of grey ghost copies behind it.

Do you have three Heavy Maulers in your hold? Then the game draws three Heavy Maulers, piled up in one little tile, the two at the back tinted grey.

It's there to tell you how many you have. There is already a number in the corner doing exactly that.

One sprite. Every screen. The number stays. Helps with the visual clutter for me

Requires LunaLib and LazyLib.

Settings
In LunaLib's settings menu (Shift+F2 in the campaign), under Icons.
Weapons - one sprite only: on by default.
Crew and marines - one sprite only: off by default. Those tiles pile up the same way, one extra portrait per 50 aboard.
Both apply on the next frame drawn, so you can flip one and watch the screen you are already looking at change.

FAQ
Can I add or remove it mid save?
Yes, both. Nothing of this mod is ever written into your save. It only changes how a screen is drawn while you are looking at it.
Does it change how much I actually have?
No. It only stops the extra sprites being drawn. The number in the corner is untouched, and so is everything the game does with the stack.
The sprite sits slightly lower when I have more than one.
That one is the game's own doing. When a tile holds more than one it shifts the front sprite down a few pixels to leave room for the pile behind it. The pile is gone, the shift stays.
What about fighter LPCs, blueprints and AI cores?
Those already draw a single sprite in vanilla. Nothing to fix.
Does it work in the simulator or in missions?
No, campaign only. Those run in a different part of the game.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 5.5)
Icon: Gemini

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.
The UIFramework code by Starficz inside it keeps its own licence (LGPL-3.0).

Version log
1.0.2
Added the mod icon, which now also shows next to the mod in LunaLib's settings menu.

1.0.1
Linked the mod to this forum thread.

1.0.0
First release. One sprite per cargo stack, everywhere the game stacks them, with a LunaLib toggle for crew and marines.

discordPostHtml:
Just a simple mod that stops sprite stacking for weapons.
I personally prefer it when sprites for weapons are only one-at-a-time, to more easily distinguish the thousands of weapons in the modsector.

Forum post: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35952.0
aiDescription: Replaces the visual pile of grey ghost sprites behind stacked items with a single sprite. The item count remains visible in the corner. Includes toggles for weapons and crew/marines in the settings menu.
